purpose: Establish why the authoritative CPU terrain has its measured latency and cost, exhaust measured standard CPU improvements, and retain a stable final CPU baseline before any GPU architecture decision is eligible.

authority_policy.correctness_precedence: No performance result may weaken topology, LOD seams, edits, collision, persistence, determinism, bounded ownership, or fail-closed behavior.
authority_policy.gpu_policy: GPU work is a candidate only after this precondition passes; it is not an assumed destination or a substitute for unresolved CPU architecture work.

cpu_release.claim: TQP-57 correctness and bounded release baseline; not CPU performance finalization

process_cpu_development_observation.claim: comparison context only; cannot promote this precondition

ordered_closure.title: Bottleneck Attribution And Benchmark Integrity
complete_when: A non-intrusive process CPU profiler passes the same correctness workload instead of invalidating its frame gate.

Cold arrival, warm arrival, traversal, flight, LOD churn, digging, construction, collision, and idle costs are separated by wall time, process CPU time, native phase time, queue wait, and publication latency.

Planning and desired-set reconciliation, storage and generation, sampling, meshing, render publication, collision build and apply, retirement, cancellation, and idle work have explicit counters and distributions.
Performance distributions use enough samples that one nearest-rank sample cannot silently stand in for p99.
Debug/editor and optimized release-runtime costs are measured separately on the pinned Godot 4.7 and hardware profile.

ordered_closure.title: Measured Standard CPU Architecture Work
complete_when: Procedural generation worker counts are swept under identical workloads and the selected profile is justified by latency, CPU work, memory, queues, frame pacing, and energy boundary.

The serial control-thread mesh path is either replaced by a bounded prepare/execute/complete worker design or retained with measured proof that parallel meshing does not materially improve the target workload.

Scheduler queue structures, repeated sorting, dependency requests, cache misses, duplicate requests, stale work, cancellation, and viewer priority are optimized only where attribution proves material cost.
Collision remains spatially targeted and generation-aware; collision work is not globally expanded to improve a benchmark.
Each accepted change passes the full CPU authority, assembled mixed-LOD, edits, collision, persistence, determinism, memory, and shutdown regressions.

ordered_closure.title: Final CPU Baseline And Exhaustion Review
complete_when: Production responsiveness targets are explicit for first correct visual, collision coherence, local edit settlement, cold teleport, sustained movement, and return to an edited area.

Low-power, balanced, quality, and reference profiles have repeatable release-runtime baselines with frame pacing, CPU time, memory, queues, throughput, responsiveness, and separate GPU-board, CPU-package, and whole-system power boundaries where providers exist.
At least three comparable repetitions establish variance and confidence for promotion metrics; long soak remains reserved for the final candidate rather than every development iteration.
Every remaining material bottleneck is classified as resolved, intentionally bounded, hardware-limited, authority-constrained, or a measured GPU candidate.
An independent fail-closed report passes and records TQP-58 eligibility without changing the CPU authority.

current_known_blockers: Production large-terrain acceptance has no accepted process-wide CPU telemetry correlated to its scenarios.
Native meshing executes synchronously on the single runtime control thread while only procedural generation has a configurable worker pool.
Queue wait, viewer planning, desired-set reconciliation, publication, and retirement phase costs are not fully attributed.
TQP-45 explicitly excludes production release latency targets, so permissive test timeouts are not production responsiveness standards.
The accepted large-terrain run is an editor/debug-native profile; optimized release-runtime parity and cost are not established.
The current 90-frame per-scenario nearest-rank p99 gate is too fragile for an instrumented architecture comparison.
Standard CPU worker and architecture alternatives have not been swept and regression-qualified under identical assembled workloads.

power_boundaries.gpu_board: nvidia-smi board power is GPU context only
power_boundaries.cpu_package: requires a trusted package-energy provider; must not be inferred from GPU-board power
power_boundaries.whole_system: requires a wall, DC-input, or platform telemetry provider; must remain separate
power_boundaries.promotion_without_cpu_package_sensor: CPU time, wall time, work throughput, and frame pacing may qualify architecture readiness, but no CPU-watt or whole-system-watt claim may be made.

invalid_promotion_evidence: A correctness-only PASS with multi-second timeouts
A single run or a run that failed its own correctness or frame gate
A benchmark with changed world, LOD, collision, edit, or visual workload
GPU-board watts relabelled as CPU-package or whole-system watts
Higher throughput obtained by stale work, missing collision, topology regressions, fallbacks, or weakened authority
